description: Synthetic FHIR-JSON prior-authorization lifecycle feed (batch bundle): PA requests carried as preauthorization Claim resources, each with an ordered statusHistory (submitted -> pending -> approved | denied -> appealed) so the domain captures a STATUS LIFECYCLE, not just a snapshot. pa-1 is an APPROVED lifecycle linked to ServiceRequest/sr-100 and the resulting Claim/c-1; pa-2 is a DENIED then APPEALED lifecycle; pa-bad is missing the patient subject (quarantine). This domain CAPTURES lifecycle data only: it references the paMachine PaState vocabulary and never sets authoritative Approved/Denied state, which comes solely from the paMachine / payer ClaimResponse. No member names; subjects are source ids anchored through the identity seam. statusHistory + relatedClaim/serviceRequest are synthetic linkage fields; real UM-system linkage is deferred to I8A.
